title: I created a prototype for an idle game where you run a boba shop
author: RoyaLTigeRRK
selftext:
Not sure if this is allowed to ask here. I want to see everyone's reaction to this game and see if it's something that would pique anyone's interest.

This is more of a chill, cozy vibe, tycoon/sims/management/idle kind of game.

The idea is to have "real time" in the game. If you open this game up at 10 AM in the morning, it would be 10am in the game, so it is reading your phone's clock. The shop is only open if you open the app. For the WFH folks, you can leave this game running in the background and only interact with it if you want to.

Any feedback is welcome and I mean it, especially since I only have this concept in my head and there are a lot of unknown unknowns for me right now.
